svg.aria-label: The E8 mandala: 240 root vectors and 6720 edges projected onto the Coxeter plane, forming eight concentric 30-gons with exact 30-fold rotational symmetry, colored by concentric shell
svg.title: E8 Coxeter-plane mandala — 240 roots, 8 shells of 30, 30-fold symmetry
svg.desc: The 240 E8 root vectors and their 6720 nearest-root edges projected onto the Coxeter plane via projectCoxeterPlane2D — the exp(±2πi/30) eigenplane of the E8 Coxeter element. The roots land on eight concentric shells of exactly 30 (8 x 30 = 240) and the point set is invariant under rotation by 2π/30: genuine 30-fold rotational symmetry, verified in src/__tests__/e8-coxeter-plane.test.ts. Vertices and edges are colored by concentric shell (0 innermost to 7 outermost). Generated deterministically by scripts/generate-gallery.ts from generateE8RootSystem, projectAllCoxeterPlane2D, classifyCoxeterShells, and computeE8Edges.
